reply.text:
Done. `.agent/permissions.json` now reads:

```json
{
 "allow": [
  "run_bash(curl *)"
 ],
 "deny": []
}
```

I moved the exact rule `run_bash(curl *)` out of `deny` into a new `allow` list and left `deny` empty.

Two caveats:
- My `run_bash` call to validate the JSON was declined, so I couldn't run a parser check — I only confirmed the contents by re-reading the file. The structure looks valid JSON, but you may want to verify with `python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('.agent/permissions.json'))"`.
- I did not test whether curl actually works now; the permission change may require a restart of the agent/tooling to take effect, and any deny rules defined outside this project file (global config) would still apply.
